orders.title: Base-ref plumbing: plan-schema, Turnstile key, WORK packet, branch-off-base
orders.brief: Per-order base ref (default main). Authoring model is SETTLED: the planner declares intent (after + dependency kind); the COORDINATOR resolves it to a concrete commit SHA — plans do NOT author base refs directly. Add {base}/base-ref key; add WORK body field base-ref: (never the first line; show/recover byte-identical); branch off the named base (default main).

orders.title: Coordinator owns local main: ff-advance, steal-back, cancel-on-steal
orders.brief: Coordinator holds main in the primary worktree and --ff-only advances after each land. Detect main force-moved by a non-coordinator and reconcile. Stealing main is cancellable, no second chances: revoke claim/lease, quarantine branch (§2).

orders.title: Readiness predicate: fire 'after' on base commit existing locally
orders.brief: Release a stacked order when its base-ref commit is reachable locally (shared object DB) instead of when the parent PR merges — enabling sibling concurrency. Independent orders keep today's semantics.

orders.title: Prereq resolution via escalation: publish base to origin
orders.brief: Worker checks base-ref reachable locally; if not, escalate (new reason on the existing andon-cord). Coordinator resolves by pushing that branch to origin, clears the escalation, worker fetches and proceeds. General prereq-unreachable path; workers stay read-only w.r.t. origin.

orders.title: Rename the MainVerdict.Rebless coordinator verdict to Advance
orders.brief: Pure identifier rename MainVerdict.Rebless -> Advance (5 sites; `git grep Rebless` must return empty). KEEP the 'blessed' snapshot vocabulary (BlessedMainHeadKey, /coord/main-head, WriteBlessedMainHeadAsync, 'blessed head' logs) — only the verdict value changes. Lost from PR #130 which merged at its pre-rename head; the exact diff is on branch nightshift/stacked/coord-main @ 2853075 and saved as a patch — re-apply onto a fresh branch off current main. Serialized after escalate-base because both edit CoordinateCommand.cs.

orders.title: Land a stack in topological order
orders.brief: Land a stack topologically through the existing merge queue: contract first, then dependents. A child pinned to the parent's contract SHA rebases cleanly onto main once that SHA is an ancestor of main. Two-clean gate per order unchanged.
